I built a careful non-vacuity argument — hypotheses `hsep` and `hc` witnessed *jointly* at one

the first question; a *conclusion-position* census answers the second. I ran the first and reported
it as if it settled the second.

*concludes* the hypothesis shape, not one that assumes it — and try to refute the hypothesis at a
natural configuration. If the only inhabitant comes from migrating a chart-typed object, ask what
produces *that*. Relatedly: when a prescription names a route, check whether the source project
already **retired** it — my whole first port was a faithful transcription of a route the chart-typed
